blurb.en: A function that calls itself: one case small enough to answer outright, and a step that hands a smaller copy of the problem back to the same function.
blurb.zh: 一个调用自己的函数：一种小到可以直接回答的情况，加上一步——把问题缩小一点，再交回给同一个函数。

en: Every recursive function has two parts. The base case is an input small enough to answer without calling anything - here, the factorial of zero. The recursive step answers a bigger input using the answer to a smaller one: 5! is 5 times 4!, and the function gets 4! by calling itself.

Nothing is multiplied on the way down. factorial(3) cannot finish until factorial(2) returns, which waits for factorial(1), which waits for factorial(0). Only when the base case returns do the multiplications happen, on the way back up: 1, then 1 times 1, then 2 times 1, then 3 times 2.

If the step did not make n smaller, or n could skip past the base case - try a negative number - the calls would never stop. Python gives up after about a thousand calls waiting inside each other and raises RecursionError; the call-stack program on this page shows it happening. The same limit means this version cannot work out factorial(1000), which the loop version on this page manages easily.
zh: 每个递归函数都有两部分。基例是一个小到不用再调用任何东西就能回答的输入——这里是零的阶乘。递归步借一个更小输入的答案来回答更大的输入：5! 等于 5 乘 4!，而函数求 4! 的办法就是调用自己。
往下走的时候一次乘法都没做。factorial(3) 要等 factorial(2) 返回才能完成，factorial(2) 等 factorial(1)，factorial(1) 等 factorial(0)。直到基例返回，乘法才在往回走的路上一次次发生：先是 1，然后 1 乘 1，然后 2 乘 1，最后 3 乘 2。
如果递归步不让 n 变小，或者 n 能跳过基例——试试负数——调用就永远停不下来。Python 在大约一千层互相等着的调用之后放弃，抛出 RecursionError；本页的「调用栈」程序演示了这一幕。同一个上限也意味着这一版算不了 factorial(1000)，而本页的循环版轻松做到。

lineNotes.en: 20! already has 19 digits. Python integers grow as large as they need to, so there is no overflow to worry about.
lineNotes.zh: 20! 已经有 19 位。Python 的整数要多大就长多大，不用担心溢出。

lineNotes.en: The recursive step written out as a comparison: two ways of getting 5!, which must agree.
lineNotes.zh: 把递归步写成一个比较：得到 5! 的两种途径，结果必须相同。

blurb.en: The same problem solved by counting up instead of calling down, keeping one running product.
blurb.zh: 同一个问题，改成往上数而不是往下调用，手里只留一个累乘的结果。

en: Here result starts at the identity for multiplication, and every whole number from 2 up to n is multiplied into it in turn. For n of 0 or 1 the range is empty, the loop body never runs, and the starting value is already the right answer - no separate base case is needed.

Put the two versions side by side. The recursive one reads like the mathematical definition; this one does the same multiplications in the opposite order, smallest first, and holds only one number as it goes.

The practical difference is the call stack. Each recursive call waits in memory until the ones below it finish, and Python stops at roughly a thousand of them, so the recursive version fails on factorial(1000). This loop makes no extra calls at all, which is why the last line of the demo can ask how many digits 1000! has.
zh: 这里 result 从乘法的单位元开始，从 2 到 n 的每个整数依次乘进去。n 为 0 或 1 时 range 是空的，循环体一次都不执行，初值本身就是正确答案——不需要另写基例。
把两个版本并排看。递归版读起来像数学定义；这一版做的是同样的乘法，只是顺序反过来、从小的先乘，一路上手里只拿着一个数。
实际的差别在调用栈。每次递归调用都要在内存里等着下面的调用完成，而 Python 到大约一千层就停，所以递归版算 factorial(1000) 会失败。这个循环根本不额外调用函数，所以演示的最后一行才能问 1000! 有多少位。

lineNotes.en: Reached for every n, including 0 and 1, where the loop ran zero times and result is still its starting value.
lineNotes.zh: 每个 n 都会走到这里，包括 0 和 1——那时循环一次没跑，result 还是初值。

lineNotes.en: Turning the number into a string and taking its length counts its digits.
lineNotes.zh: 把数转成字符串再取长度，就数出了它有几位。

blurb.en: The Fibonacci definition copied almost word for word into recursion - with a counter that shows how much repeated work that costs.
blurb.zh: 把斐波那契的定义几乎逐字抄成递归——再加一个计数器，看看这样要重复做多少事。

en: The Fibonacci sequence has two base cases and a step that looks back two places: fib(0) is 0, fib(1) is 1, and every later term is the sum of the two before it. Written as recursion, the function is almost a copy of that definition.

Copying the definition is not the same as being efficient. fib(5) calls fib(4) and fib(3); fib(4) calls fib(3) again, and so on down, so the same small values are worked out over and over. The counter shows the cost: each step up in n multiplies the number of calls by about 1.6, and fib(20) already takes more than twenty thousand.

calls lives at the top of the module so its value survives from one call of fib to the next, and the global line is what lets fib change it. The main block resets it to 0 before each measurement. The other three Fibonacci programs on this page remove the repeated work in three different ways - compare them with this one.
zh: 斐波那契数列有两个基例和一步往回看两格的递推：fib(0) 是 0，fib(1) 是 1，之后每一项都是前两项之和。写成递归，函数几乎就是这条定义的照抄。
照抄定义不等于高效。fib(5) 调用 fib(4) 和 fib(3)；fib(4) 又调用一次 fib(3)，一路往下都是这样，同样的小值被一遍又一遍地重算。计数器把代价摆了出来：n 每加 1，调用次数大约乘 1.6，fib(20) 就已经要两万多次。
calls 放在模块顶层，它的值才能从 fib 的这一次调用留到下一次；global 那一行让 fib 可以改它。主程序在每次测量之前把它清零。本页另外三个斐波那契程序用三种不同的办法去掉了重复计算——拿它们和这一个对照着看。

lineNotes.en: Reset before each n, so every count starts from zero.
lineNotes.zh: 每换一个 n 先清零，每次计数都从零开始。

lineNotes.en: Two calls for every call that gets this far: this line is why the count grows exponentially.
lineNotes.zh: 每个走到这里的调用都会再发出两个调用：调用次数指数增长，根子就在这一行。

run.expect:
fib(5) = 5 after 15 calls
fib(10) = 55 after 177 calls
fib(15) = 610 after 1973 calls
fib(20) = 6765 after 21891 calls

title.zh: 斐波那契：手写字典记忆化

blurb.en: The naive recursion again, with a dictionary that remembers every answer so no value is ever worked out twice.
blurb.zh: 还是那个朴素递归，但配一个字典记住每个答案，任何一个值都不再算第二遍。

en: Memoisation means remembering answers. memo maps each n already worked out to its Fibonacci number, and before doing any work fib checks whether the answer is already there. Each value is calculated once; every later request for it is a single dictionary lookup.
The base cases are no longer a separate if - they are simply the first two entries in memo, so fib(0) and fib(1) are found in the dictionary like any other value that is already known.

After fib(10), memo holds one entry for each value from 0 to 10 - one per value, not one per call. fib(90) would take the naive version longer than anyone would wait; here it adds eighty more entries and finishes at once. The dictionary lives at module level, so it keeps what it has learned from one call of fib to the next.
zh: 记忆化就是把答案记下来。memo 把每个已经算过的 n 映射到它的斐波那契数；fib 动手之前先查答案是不是已经在里面。每个值只算一次，之后再要它，只是查一次字典。
基例不再是单独的一个 if——它们就是 memo 里最早的两项，fib(0) 和 fib(1) 跟其他已知的值一样，是从字典里查出来的。
fib(10) 之后，memo 里 0 到 10 每个值各有一项——按值计，不按调用计。fib(90) 让朴素版去算，谁都等不起；这里它只是多加八十来项，瞬间算完。字典放在模块顶层，所以它学到的东西会从 fib 的这一次调用留到下一次。

lineNotes.en: By this line the answer is always in memo: either it was there already, or the lines above have just put it there.
lineNotes.zh: 走到这一行时答案一定在 memo 里：要么本来就在，要么上面几行刚把它放进去。

lineNotes.en: fib(50) was worked out on the way to fib(90), so this call finds it in memo without doing any new work.
lineNotes.zh: fib(50) 在算 fib(90) 的路上就已经算过了，所以这次调用直接在 memo 里找到它，不做任何新计算。

blurb.en: The naive function body, untouched, with one decorator line that makes the standard library do the remembering.
blurb.zh: 朴素版的函数体一字不改，只加一行装饰器，让标准库替你记答案。

en: The function body is exactly the naive version. The decorator line above the def wraps it in a cache: whenever fib is called, the wrapper first looks the argument up and only runs the body on a miss. It is the memo dictionary from the previous program, written and managed by the standard library.

cache_info() reports what the cache has done. For fib(30) there is one miss for each value from 0 to 30, each worked out once, and the hits are the repeated requests that used to cost an exponential number of calls. Asking for fib(30) a second time costs one more hit and nothing else.

The cache here is given no size limit, so it never throws anything away. Given a limit instead, lru_cache keeps only that many results and drops the least recently used first, which is where the name comes from. A companion method empties the cache on request. The cached values last only while the program runs; nothing is saved to disk.
zh: 函数体和朴素版一模一样。def 上面那行装饰器把它包进一个缓存：每次调用 fib，包装层先按实参查一遍，查不到才去执行函数体。它就是上一个程序里的 memo 字典，只不过由标准库替你写好、替你管着。
cache_info() 报告缓存做了什么。算 fib(30) 时，0 到 30 每个值各有一次未命中，每个只算一次；命中则是那些重复的请求——原先要花指数级的调用次数。第二次要 fib(30)，只多一次命中，别的什么都不用做。
这里的缓存没有设大小上限，所以从不丢东西。设了上限的话，lru_cache 就只留那么多个结果，先丢最久没用过的——名字就是这么来的。另有一个配套的方法，要时就把缓存清空。缓存的值只在程序运行期间存在，不会写到磁盘上。

lineNotes.en: cache_info returns a named tuple, so its fields can be read by name: hits, misses, currsize.
lineNotes.zh: cache_info 返回一个具名元组，字段可以按名字读：hits、misses、currsize。

lineNotes.en: Read straight after clearing, so the cache holds nothing.
lineNotes.zh: 紧跟在清空之后读，缓存里什么都没有。

title.zh: 斐波那契：两个变量滚动

blurb.en: No recursion and no dictionary: two variables slide along the sequence one step per loop.
blurb.zh: 不递归，也不用字典：两个变量每轮沿数列往前滑一格。

en: a and b always hold two neighbouring Fibonacci numbers, and each pass of the loop slides that pair one place along the sequence. After n passes, a holds fib(n).

The simultaneous assignment is what makes the slide work. Python evaluates the whole right-hand side first, using the old a and b, and only then stores both results. Written as two separate assignments, the second would read an a that had already been overwritten.

The loop variable is called _ by convention: the body never uses the count, it only needs to run n times. This version and the memo versions do about the same amount of work - roughly n additions - but this one needs no dictionary and no call stack, so fib(1000) is no trouble.
zh: a 和 b 始终是一对相邻的斐波那契数，循环每跑一轮，这一对就沿数列往前滑一格。跑完 n 轮，a 就是 fib(n)。
能滑得动，靠的是同时赋值。Python 先用旧的 a 和 b 把右边整个算完，然后才把两个结果存回去。拆成两条单独的赋值，第二条读到的 a 就已经被改掉了。
循环变量按惯例叫 _：循环体根本不用这个计数，只需要跑 n 次。这一版和记忆化的几版工作量差不多——大约 n 次加法——但它不要字典、不占调用栈，所以 fib(1000) 毫无压力。

lineNotes.en: For n = 0 the loop does not run at all and a is still 0, which is fib(0).
lineNotes.zh: n = 0 时循环一次都不跑，a 还是 0，正是 fib(0)。

lineNotes.en: a, not b: after n passes a is fib(n) and b is already one step ahead.
lineNotes.zh: 交回 a 而不是 b：跑完 n 轮，a 是 fib(n)，b 已经多走了一步。

title.en: The Call Stack, Winding and Unwinding

blurb.en: Indented enter and leave lines that show each call waiting for the one inside it - and what happens when nothing ever stops the calls.
blurb.zh: 用缩进的进入 / 离开两行，看清每个调用都在等它里面那一层——再看看调用永远停不下来时会怎样。

en: Every call gets its own frame on the call stack, with its own n and its own depth. countdown prints its enter line, makes its recursive call, and prints its leave line only after that call has returned. So the enter lines come out in the order the calls were made and the leave lines in reverse order: the last call made is the first to finish.

depth is there only to draw the picture. It goes up by one per level and repeats a four-space string that many times, so each frame's lines sit one step further right than its caller's. The base case is n reaching 0: that call makes no further call, prints its leave line straight away, and the stack starts to unwind.

no_base_case has nothing that stops it. Each call makes another, the stack keeps growing, and Python refuses to go past its recursion limit - about a thousand frames by default - by raising RecursionError. The except clause catches it and prints only the exception's class name, because the wording of the message can change between Python versions.
zh: 每次调用都在调用栈上得到一个自己的栈帧，有自己的 n 和自己的 depth。countdown 先打印进入那一行，再发出递归调用，要等那次调用返回之后才打印离开那一行。所以进入的行按调用发出的先后出现，离开的行顺序正好相反：最后发出的调用最先结束。
depth 只是为了画出这幅图。它每深一层加一，把一个四空格的字符串重复那么多次，于是每一层的输出都比调用它的那一层再往右缩进一级。基例是 n 走到 0：那次调用不再往下调，立刻打印离开的行，栈从这里开始往回退。
no_base_case 没有任何能让它停下的情况。每次调用都发出下一次，栈一直长，Python 到了递归上限——默认大约一千层——就拒绝继续，抛出 RecursionError。except 子句接住它，只打印异常的类名，因为异常消息的措辞在不同的 Python 版本之间可能不同。

lineNotes.en: A string times a whole number repeats the string: depth 2 gives eight spaces.
lineNotes.zh: 字符串乘一个整数就是把它重复那么多次：depth 为 2 时是八个空格。

lineNotes.en: Runs only after the recursive call above has completely finished, however deep it went.
lineNotes.zh: 上面那次递归调用无论走得多深，都要彻底结束之后才轮到这一行。

run.expect:
enter countdown(3)
    enter countdown(2)
        enter countdown(1)
            enter countdown(0)
            leave countdown(0)
        leave countdown(1)
    leave countdown(2)
leave countdown(3)
Stopped by RecursionError

blurb.en: x to the power n, one factor of x per call - so n + 1 calls in all.
blurb.zh: x 的 n 次方，每次调用剥下一个 x——总共要调用 n + 1 次。

en: x to the power n is x multiplied by itself n times. Recursion says the same thing as: x to the n is x times x to the n - 1, and x to the 0 is 1. Each call peels off one factor of x and hands the rest of the job to the next call.

Because n shrinks by only one each time, x to the n takes n + 1 calls, the last one being the base case. That is linear growth: double n and the work doubles, and a large enough n runs into Python's recursion limit.

Compare it with the halving version of the same function on this page. Only the lines after the base case differ - the counter and the demo are identical - so the difference in the number of calls comes entirely from how n is made smaller.
zh: x 的 n 次方就是 x 自乘 n 次。用递归的话说：x 的 n 次方等于 x 乘 x 的 n - 1 次方，x 的 0 次方是 1。每次调用剥下一个 x，把剩下的活交给下一次调用。
n 每次只减一，所以算 x 的 n 次方要调用 n + 1 次，最后一次是基例。这是线性增长：n 翻倍，工作量也翻倍；n 足够大时还会撞上 Python 的递归上限。
把它和本页同一个函数的折半版对照着看。两者只有基例之后的几行不同——计数器和演示完全一样——所以调用次数的差别完全来自 n 是怎么变小的。

lineNotes.en: The same counter technique as the naive Fibonacci program: this line lets the function change the module-level calls.
lineNotes.zh: 和朴素斐波那契程序一样的计数手法：这一行让函数能改模块顶层的 calls。

lineNotes.en: The call is stored first and printed afterwards, so calls has finished counting by the time it is shown.
lineNotes.zh: 先调用、存起来，再打印——显示 calls 的时候它已经数完了。

blurb.en: Halve n instead of stepping it down by one, and the number of calls grows like log n instead of n.
blurb.zh: 不是把 n 一次减一，而是一次折半——调用次数从随 n 增长变成随 log n 增长。

en: Instead of stepping n down by one, halve it. x to the 10 is x to the 5, squared; x to the 5 is x to the 2, squared, times one extra x because 5 is odd. Every call makes a single recursive call on half of n, then does at most two multiplications.
Halving reaches zero quickly: n = 100 goes 100, 50, 25, 12, 6, 3, 1, 0 - eight calls instead of 101. The number of calls grows like log base 2 of n, so doubling n adds only one more call.

The half power is worked out once, stored, and used twice. Making the recursive call twice instead, once for each factor, would give exactly the same answer but make two calls at every level - and all of the saving would disappear. The result would not change; the counter would.
zh: 不把 n 一次减一，而是折半。x 的 10 次方是 x 的 5 次方的平方；x 的 5 次方是 x 的 2 次方的平方，因为 5 是奇数，还要再乘一个 x。每次调用只对一半的 n 递归一次，然后最多做两次乘法。
折半很快就到零：n = 100 依次是 100、50、25、12、6、3、1、0——八次调用而不是 101 次。调用次数按以 2 为底的 log n 增长，n 翻倍只多一次调用。
一半次幂只算一次，存起来，用两次。要是改成每个因子各发一次递归调用，答案完全一样，但每一层都变成两次调用——省下的全部白费。结果不会变，计数器会。

lineNotes.en: The base case is the same as in the linear version; everything after it is what changed.
lineNotes.zh: 基例和线性版一样；变了的是它后面的所有行。

lineNotes.en: The same demo line as the linear version, so the two call counts can be compared directly.
lineNotes.zh: 和线性版一模一样的演示行，两边的调用次数可以直接对比。

blurb.en: The classic puzzle solved with one idea: to move n discs, move n - 1 of them twice.
blurb.zh: 用一个想法解开这道经典谜题：要搬 n 个盘子，就把其中 n - 1 个搬两次。

en: The puzzle: move a stack of n discs from one peg to another, one disc at a time, never putting a larger disc on a smaller one, with a third peg to help. Planning every move by hand is hopeless; recursion needs only one idea. To move n discs, move the top n - 1 out of the way onto the spare peg, move the biggest disc to the target, then move the n - 1 back on top of it.

Moving n - 1 discs is the same puzzle with a smaller n and the pegs in different roles, so the function calls itself for it - twice. The base case is zero discs, which need no moves at all: an empty list.

The function returns the moves instead of printing them, as a list of (from, to) tuples, so the caller can print them, count them or check them. The counts follow the rule 2 to the n, minus 1: each extra disc doubles the number of moves and adds one.
zh: 谜题是这样的：把一摞 n 个盘子从一根柱子搬到另一根，一次搬一个，大盘子永远不能压在小盘子上，还有第三根柱子可以借用。想靠手算规划每一步是没指望的；递归只需要一个想法。要搬 n 个盘子，先把上面 n - 1 个挪到借用柱上让开，把最大的盘子搬到目标柱，再把那 n - 1 个搬回来压在它上面。
搬 n - 1 个盘子是同一道谜题，只是 n 更小、柱子的角色换了，所以函数为它调用自己——调用两次。基例是零个盘子，一步都不用走：一个空列表。
函数把移动步骤交回来而不是直接打印，是一个 (出发柱, 目标柱) 元组的列表，调用方想打印、想计数、想检查都行。步数符合 2 的 n 次方减 1 的规律：每多一个盘子，步数翻倍再加一。

lineNotes.en: Each move is a tuple, unpacked straight into two loop variables.
lineNotes.zh: 每一步是一个元组，直接拆进两个循环变量。

lineNotes.en: Zero discs, zero moves. Every call eventually bottoms out here, which is what lets the lists be joined on the way back up.
lineNotes.zh: 零个盘子，零步。每次调用最终都会走到这里，往回走的路上各段列表才拼得起来。

blurb.en: Every ordering of a string: choose each character in turn to go first, then find every ordering of what is left.
blurb.zh: 一个字符串的所有排列：轮流让每个字符排第一，再求剩下字符的所有排列。

en: Every ordering of abc starts with a, b or c. The ones starting with a are a followed by every ordering of bc; the ones starting with b are b followed by every ordering of ac; and so on. That is the recursion: for each position, take that character as first, find all orderings of what is left, and put first in front of each one.

The base case is a string of length 0 or 1, which has exactly one ordering: itself. That includes the empty string, whose one ordering is the empty string - so the result is a list holding one empty string, not an empty list.

A string of n different characters has n factorial orderings, which is why abcde gives 120. Repeated characters get no special treatment, so aab produces duplicates. The results come out in the same order as itertools.permutations from the standard library, which does the same job.
zh: abc 的每一种排列都以 a、b 或 c 开头。以 a 开头的，是 a 后面跟 bc 的每一种排列；以 b 开头的，是 b 后面跟 ac 的每一种排列；以此类推。这就是递归：对每个位置，把那个字符当作第一个，求出剩下字符的所有排列，再把它接到每一种的前面。
基例是长度为 0 或 1 的字符串，它恰好只有一种排列：它自己。空字符串也算在内，它唯一的排列就是空字符串——所以结果是装着一个空字符串的列表，而不是空列表。
n 个互不相同的字符有 n 的阶乘种排列，所以 abcde 得到 120。重复的字符不做特殊处理，所以 aab 会产生重复项。结果的先后顺序与标准库里做同一件事的 itertools.permutations 相同。

lineNotes.en: enumerate hands over each index together with its character: i is needed for slicing, first for building the results.
lineNotes.zh: enumerate 把每个下标连同它的字符一起交出来：切片要用 i，拼结果要用 first。

lineNotes.en: A list with one string in it, not the string itself - the caller loops over the result.
lineNotes.zh: 装着一个字符串的列表，而不是字符串本身——调用方要遍历这个结果。

title.zh: 展平任意深度的嵌套列表

blurb.en: Lists inside lists inside lists, to any depth, turned into one flat list by a function that treats every level the same way.
blurb.zh: 列表套列表、想套多深就多深，由一个对每一层一视同仁的函数展成一个平的列表。

en: A nested list is a list whose items may themselves be lists, to any depth. Loops alone cannot handle that: you would need one more loop for every level, and you do not know how many levels there are. Recursion treats every level the same way - plain values are kept, and any list that turns up is flattened by the same function.

isinstance asks whether an object is of a given type. Strings and tuples are not lists, so they are kept as single items rather than taken apart; the last line of the demo keeps the string and the tuple whole.

extend adds every element of another list one by one; append would add the flattened list as one single item and put the nesting straight back. Empty lists contribute nothing, which is why the second demo line is left with a single number.
zh: 嵌套列表就是元素本身也可能是列表的列表，想套多深就多深。光靠循环处理不了：每多一层就得多写一层循环，而你并不知道有几层。递归对每一层一视同仁——普通的值留下，遇到列表就交给同一个函数去展平。
isinstance 问的是一个对象是不是某个类型。字符串和元组都不是列表，所以它们作为单个元素留下，不会被拆开；演示的最后一行就把字符串和元组原样留着。
extend 把另一个列表的元素逐个加进来；append 会把展平后的列表当作一个元素加进去，嵌套马上又回来了。空列表什么都不贡献，所以演示的第二行最后只剩一个数。

lineNotes.en: Every call builds and returns its own new list; the caller copies its elements in.
lineNotes.zh: 每次调用都建一个自己的新列表并交回；调用方再把其中的元素接进去。

lineNotes.en: Looks at the items of this level only; anything deeper is left to a recursive call.
lineNotes.zh: 只看这一层的元素；更深的层交给递归调用。
